Class FFT

java.lang.Object
math.FFT
public class FFT extends Object
Computes FFT's of complex, double precision data where n is an integer power of 2. This appears to be slower than the Radix2 method, but the code is smaller and simpler, and it requires no extra storage. <P>
Author:
Bruce R. Miller bruce.miller@nist.gov,, Derived from GSL (Gnu Scientific Library),, GSL's FFT Code by Brian Gough bjg@vvv.lanl.gov
